nodes.label: twine CLI
nodes.desc: dispatch() reads twine.registered_commands entry points, prints dependency versions with --version, routes args to the chosen main()

nodes.label: twine upload
nodes.desc: upload(): check_repository_url, build packages, loop uploads, abort on redirects (bug 92), print release URLs

nodes.label: twine check
nodes.desc: check(): renders long_description per dist, PASSED/FAILED with warnings under --strict

nodes.label: skip_upload
nodes.desc: treats pypiserver 409 and PyPI/TestPyPI 400 'already exist' as ignorable when --skip-existing

nodes.label: dist discovery
nodes.desc: _find_dists expands globs and sorts wheels first; _split_inputs buckets *.asc signatures and *.*.attestation files

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.desc: keyword-only Settings; verify_feature_capability gates --skip-existing to PyPI; check_repository_url rejects legacy pypi.python.org

nodes.label: Resolver
nodes.desc: cached properties for username/password; defaults username to __token__ on PyPI; falls back through keyring then prompt

nodes.label: TrustedPublishing
nodes.desc: fetches /_/oidc/audience, exchanges CI OIDC token at /_/oidc/mint-token, caches for 900s with 5-minute renewal threshold

nodes.label: .pypirc reader
nodes.desc: get_config parses ~/.pypirc with UTF-8 retry; server-login defaults kept for compat; index-servers default 'pypi testpypi'

nodes.label: Env argparse
nodes.desc: EnvironmentDefault and EnvironmentFlag map TWINE_USERNAME/TWINE_PASSWORD/TWINE_REPOSITORY_URL onto argparse

nodes.label: requests Session
nodes.desc: make_requests_session mounts urllib3 Retry (GET only, connect=5, total=10, 500-503) and twine's user-agent string

nodes.label: Exceptions
nodes.desc: TwineException subclasses incl. InvalidDistribution, NonInteractive, TrustedPublishingFailure, UnsupportedConfiguration

nodes.label: PackageFile
nodes.desc: from_filename dispatches by extension, then parses and validates metadata before constructing the file record

nodes.label: Field mapping
nodes.desc: _RAW_TO_PACKAGE_METADATA renames raw metadata keys to the upload-form names (platforms->platform, license_files->license_file)

nodes.label: Metadata gate
nodes.desc: drops License-File below Metadata-Version 2.4, rejects any unparsed field, validates via packaging.metadata.Metadata.from_raw

nodes.label: HashManager
nodes.desc: streams sha256 and blake2b(digest_size=32); blake2 silently skipped under FIPS mode (issue 775)

nodes.label: GPG signing
nodes.desc: sign() shells out gpg --detach-sign, falls back to gpg2; PyPI silently ignores signatures since May 2023

nodes.label: SDist factory
nodes.desc: __new__ picks TarGzSDist or ZipSDist by extension; py_version is 'source'

nodes.label: TarGzSDist
nodes.desc: requires a single top-level dir and reads its PKG-INFO, refusing archives without Metadata-Version

nodes.label: ZipSDist
nodes.desc: same PKG-INFO contract for zip sdists via zipfile

nodes.label: Wheel
nodes.desc: find_candidate_metadata_files ranks shortest *.dist-info paths, then demands a METADATA with Metadata-Version

nodes.label: wheel_file_re
nodes.desc: verbose regex parses name-version-build-pyver-abi-plat from the .whl filename to answer py_version

nodes.label: Distribution base
nodes.desc: abstract read() plus default py_version 'any' shared by SDist and Wheel

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.desc: endpoint constants LEGACY_PYPI, WAREHOUSE (upload.pypi.org), TEST_WAREHOUSE; session auth from username/password

nodes.label: _upload
nodes.desc: converts metadata to form tuples, appends :action=file_upload and protocol_version=1, streams via MultipartEncoder with a rich progress bar

nodes.label: 5xx retry
nodes.desc: upload() retries up to max_redirects=5 on 500-599 responses; post uses allow_redirects=False

nodes.label: exists check
nodes.desc: only for PyPI-family URLs; GETs legacy pypi/{safe_name}/json and caches releases per safe_name

nodes.label: release_urls
nodes.desc: maps upload hosts to pypi.org/test.pypi.org project pages for the 'View at' footer

nodes.label: _RENDERERS
nodes.desc: content-type table: text/x-rst via readme_renderer; text/plain and text/markdown cannot fail; missing type defaults to rst

nodes.label: _WarningStream
nodes.desc: regex reformats docutils <string>:N: (SEVERE/N) noise into 'line N: Level: message'

nodes.label: check_status_code
nodes.desc: 410 on pypi.python.org suggests migration, 405 on pypi.org points at the right legacy/ URLs, else raise_for_status

nodes.label: URL validators
nodes.desc: _validate_repository_url enforces http(s) + host via rfc3986; sanitize_url replaces userinfo with 8 asterisks; configparser errors masked to hide tokens
